verdict.rationale: A state business-filing portal could plausibly offer a test or sandbox environment for integrators, so this axis applies. The evidence only shows bot walls (Akamai 403 and Incapsula interstitials) at the front door and at the ORION filing portal. Nothing documents a sandbox, test environment, or way to exercise filings without touching production data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
